## What's Changed

- Improved the existing bounded investigation flow with latest/earliest samples and a same-time-scope fallback when proposed filters return no rows.
- Separated sample citations from source aggregation totals; unsupported findings are removed, and insufficient sampled evidence is no longer presented as an all-clear.
- Clarified investigation coverage, hypothesis limits, supported sources, and evidence wording in the app, documentation, and website.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/InvestiGenie/investigenie/compare/0.4.0-alpha...0.4.1-alpha
